== Description ==

At a table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Brian Fred]] (seated centre-left, black Colts sleeveless jersey) playing a grey-T-shirt opponent (unlabeled), with onlookers [[Steve Harpster]] (standing left, grey shirt and white beard), [[Brandon Baity]] (standing back right, olive zip jacket), and [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (standing far right, black Mariners cap); other onlookers unlabeled.
